Prior step note: Rework 4eb1eb4 answers design review DR-01 and DR-02; see design.md Review response. DR-01: AuditController admits only while Boot's effective ServerProperties.getForwardHeadersStrategy() is NONE. native, framework and null (unset, platform default) close the read for every request. Probe P6 on a real Tomcat: 403 for plain and forged X-Forwarded-For 127.0.0.2 / Forwarded for=127.0.0.2 under native, framework, unset and unset+kubernetes; under none, plain is admitted and forged is refused. Test mapping in section 7: MockMvc override contexts, the real-Tomcat kubernetes case, the shipped-file check, a unit test per strategy. DR-02: no produces condition; the handler presets application/json. Under Accept text/html, application/problem+json or */*, refusals give 403 and limit=0 gives 400, both problems, and a valid read gives 200 application/json; no 406 (P6). ADR-0019, the docs/DESIGN.md Audit read row and the impact analysis are updated.
